title: Alien 3 #1 of 3 Dark Horse Comics 1992 Arthur Suydam Painted Cover Movie Comic
conditionDescription: Six copies available; all in a similar Very Good range with clean glossy covers and light handling wear. Photos show one of the copies. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copies being sold.
descriptionText:
Alien 3 #1 (of 3) (Dark Horse Comics, 1992) -- first issue of the official movie adaptation, by Steven Grant, Christopher Taylor and Rick Magyar, with the Arthur Suydam painted cover. Back cover carries the Dark Horse house ad for the RoboCop 3 adaptation. Cover price $2.50 US.

Condition: Six copies available; all in a similar Very Good range with clean glossy covers and light handling wear. Photos show one of the copies. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copies being sold.
